action_items: In RateWall.jsx, also render the '🎁 Δώρο' gift chip (data-testid=gift-badge) inside the parlay branch (near the PARLAY · N GAMES pill around line 941-945), so parlay gift picks visually show they are gifts when viewed in other category tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: RateWall.jsx is 1122 lines — consider splitting TipCard, category tabs and settle logic into separate modules for maintainability.

gift-badge conditional is duplicated logic tightly coupled to pick_type meta lookup; extracting a small <CategoryChips tip={tip} /> component would DRY up single vs parlay branches and prevent this class of miss.
